title: The Agent-DLC Flywheel
html:
What this group does: the six phases are one storyline around a single customer-service agent, lab-service-assistant — write down what "good" means so it can be checked, build the agent, use the standard to prove it meets the bar, sign it into production, see what happens there, and turn what you find into the next version of the standard.

Phase Chapter Question it answers Main accounts
1 Define What does "good" mean? developer, biz-owner
2 Build How is the agent written and deployed? developer
3 Evaluate Does it meet the bar right now? developer, sme, biz-owner
4 Release How do we ship it safely? release-ops
5 Observe What is happening in production? developer, biz-owner, admin
6 Feed Back How do we make the next round better? sme, biz-owner, developer

When this group ends: lab-service-assistant runs on the live endpoint with a signed criteria table, a sealed golden set and one complete release record behind it, and criteria table v2 is published by developer and signed by biz-owner, so the next release is judged against it.

Do the six phases in order: every chapter's prerequisites are the state the previous one left behind (criteria table, golden set, candidate version, release record). Each chapter opens with a "Prerequisites" section listing what it needs.
